channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Chaos in France as Student Protesters Clash With Police
item.description: A new wave of student protests broke out across France on Tuesday over what activists call poor school conditions, including overcrowded classrooms.

item.title: Poll: Most Americans Oppose Livestreaming Hasan Execution
item.description: A narrow majority supports executing the Fort Hood shooter by firing squad.

item.title: Houthis attack Saudi capital as Trump weighs response
item.description: Iran-backed Houthis launched a new attack on Saudi Arabia and vowed more, as Trump considers U.S. action on a new front in the wider Middle East conflict.

item.title: Midterms raise a common question: where's the beef?
item.description: In the midterm elections, meat has become an unexpected political issue.
